replace_target_nodes_with: replace target nodes in a GraphModule matching an old op and target with a new op and target
get_size_of_all_nodes: get size of all nodes in a GraphModule by annotating each node with its total and output size in bytes
get_size_of_node: get the total and output size in bytes of a single GraphModule node including weights and parameters
get_tensor_meta: retrieve tensor metadata from a node after shape propagation has been run
size_bytes: create a size_bytes NamedTuple containing output_size and total_size fields for node size reporting
